name: 字幕と通話言語の設定グループ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0007 字幕と通話言語の設定グループ.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE two-row caption/language settings group from original region16,316,358,140 normalized. Only Japanese labels: section 字幕; row1 字幕を表示 with subtitle この通話の発言を表示します; row2 通話で使用する言語 with value 日本語. Preserve locked Meiryo Regular row14/24, section and subtitle/value12/16, tracking0. Source ORIGINAL controls icons: first a rounded rectangle caption badge containing the actual CC glyph, NOT the mock's speech bubble; second a globe circle with symmetric latitude/longitude grid matching source, NOT rough mock substitute. Use white source glyphs on equal slate#526173 rounded tiles. Row1 has neutral OFF toggle with LEFT white thumb. Row2 has small light-neutral right chevron. White rounded single group, fine inset divider starts at label column, restrained shadow; heading on pure-white canvas above, no extra outer card. Preserve source alignment and small control proportions; compact logical358px width with64px rows, enlarged uniformly into readable wide image around1536x800 with restrained white margins. Do not copy English settings labels, only the original CC icon glyph is retained as icon artwork. No added features or controls.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Adapt both supporting tiles consistently to slate; group is already explicit through 字幕 heading and card. Keep OFF neutral. No primary action or enabled state needs green. Preserve original badge/globe geometry.
reviewNotes: 原版優先でCC badgeとglobeを復元し、OFF左つまみ、5日本語文字列と白面を目視確認。紫groupをslateに統一、OFFは無彩色。要修正:主ラベルがmockのMeiryo Regularより太く見えるため文字weightのみ対象修正。実操作/native編集/所有者承認なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
